attribution.statement: Account svc-reports was used for a console session (records#32, pts/2) that exported readings-q4 and sent it to 198.51.100.28:443 within approved change CH-044. No badge is assigned to the account, so no person is established. Account used; human operator not established.

alternative_explanations: Unauthorized use of svc-reports during a change window would look the same in flow data
assumptions: Change record CH-044 as shown in the policy syslog is authentic and was approved
findings.rationale: A 6.4 MB (above the 5 MB threshold) export of readings-q4 by svc-reports left records and went to 198.51.100.28:443. The destination is named in approved change CH-044 (readings-q4 to archive store, 10:03:00-10:04:00), and the transfer falls inside that window. The gateway accepted and delivered it as request D-301. The destination is not on the standing approved list (198.51.100.16), but CH-044 covers it, so the transfer is policy-consistent.
verifier_notes: a deterministic check supports this observation; it is not an incident allegation

open_questions: Confirm CH-044 approval independently of the policy syslog copy.
Shell history and file metadata are not in the bundle, so the command behind the export and any pre-transfer staging cannot be seen.
No heartbeat data for records, so collection gaps there cannot be measured.
Who operated svc-reports session records#32 is unknown.
summary: Bundle bndl-d4e2a678d0b83a32 (21 events, 10:00-10:08 UTC on 2026-11-14) does not support an incident. The one bulk transfer (6.4 MB export of readings-q4 by svc-reports, session records#32, to 198.51.100.28:443 at 10:03:20-10:03:22) is above the 5 MB threshold and not on the standing approved list, but it falls inside change CH-044, which names that destination and dataset for 10:03-10:04. It is therefore policy-consistent. The records access log matches the collector copy exactly, with no unexplained local absences, so no log removal is shown. No staging evidence was found, but file metadata is absent, so staging cannot be ruled out. Attribution: account svc-reports used; human operator not established (no badge assigned to the account).
system_label: Fast investigation: one agent with deterministic checks, no delegation (same configuration as benchmark arm B1+)
